official.deadline_note: The application period starts on 1 October 2026 and applications must be submitted by 15 October 2026 via the Requests interface of the Neptun system; there is no opportunity to submit a request for an extension and incomplete or late applications will be rejected. Evaluation is completed by 30 October 2026 and a rejection may be appealed within 5 business days.

official.international_eligibility: Open to foreign nationals only - the scholarship exists to support foreign nationals with student status at Semmelweis University; Hungarian citizens are not the target group.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Enrolment in a German- or English-taught programme at the Faculty of Medicine, Faculty of Dentistry, Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Faculty of Health Sciences or the Andras Peto Faculty of Semmelweis University.

official.description: Introduced by Semmelweis University in 2025, the merit-based Pannonia In Excellence Scholarship supports the studies of foreign nationals who have obtained student status, offering support to complete a university degree and reach full potential in sports or the arts. Evaluation of performance is determined by academic progress as well as achievements in sports and the arts, and the scholarship is awarded for one year, paid in 12 equal monthly instalments while active student status is maintained.
official.program_type: University merit-based stipend for international students

applicant_utility.summary: This is an internal, merit-only stipend for fee-paying international students already enrolled at Semmelweis, not an admission scholarship - you must already hold active student status with at least two completed semesters before you can even apply. The 15 October 2026 cut-off is absolute: the request goes through the Neptun Requests interface (never email), incomplete or late files are rejected with no extension possible, and decisions land by 30 October 2026 leaving only five business days to appeal. Money arrives as 12 monthly HUF transfers to the bank account you register as default in Neptun, so an HUF-capable account must be in place before the committee decides, and payments stop the moment your student status goes inactive.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-performing fee-paying international students at Semmelweis in Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Health Sciences or the Andras Peto Faculty who started in autumn 2024 or later, are not on Stipendium Hungaricum or the Diaspora Scholarship, and come from a Category 1 country.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your citizenship appears in Appendix 1 of the call and note whether it sits in Category 1, which is evaluated with preference over Category 2.

Check that your student status was established between September 2024 and September 2027 and that two active semesters are completed with strong grades (and any sports or arts achievements documented) before 1 October.
Register a bank account able to receive HUF transfers as the default account in your Neptun profile before applying - without it the award cannot be paid.
Watch the university website and Neptun for the exact opening time of the Requests interface and submit between 1 and 15 October 2026.
If you also hold a KITA scholarship for the year, expect the Pannonia In Excellence amount to replace it rather than add to it.
common_rejection_risks: Submitting late or with missing data - the call states there is no opportunity to request an extension and incomplete or late applications are rejected.
Holding Stipendium Hungaricum or the Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship, which makes an applicant ineligible outright.
Having fewer than two completed active semesters, or a student status established before September 2024 or after September 2027.
A previous cycle in which the evaluation committee or ethics committee found the applicant provided false information or misled reviewers.
No HUF-capable default bank account registered in Neptun, so the benefit cannot be disbursed.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The call publishes no tuition, accommodation, insurance or travel support, so tuition fees, housing, health insurance and travel to and from Budapest remain the student's own expense; the award is a monthly stipend only.
document_audit: The call itemises no upload list - 'all required documents and data' are completed inside the Neptun Requests form, so treat the Neptun request itself as the whole application.
The bank account must be capable of receiving HUF transfers and set as the Neptun default; a foreign-currency-only account blocks payment.
Name, contact information and bank account number can be amended after submission if mistakes or changes occur - audit your Neptun record before 15 October.
Keep evidence of sports or arts achievements eligible for the evaluation, since performance is judged on academic progress plus those achievements.
alerts: Appeals are short-fused: a rejection can only be contested within 5 business days of the notification, in writing to the Head of the Center of International Training Programs, stating the specific action or omission challenged.
Going passive stops the money: payments cease if student status is suspended or terminated, and the unused portion goes to the next student on the waiting list.

Repayment clause: the full amount must be repaid if you transfer to another institution, are expelled, or terminate status for non-compelling reasons, and false information triggers full repayment as well.
This is a renewal, not a one-shot - you can reapply each year, but only while still an active student; once you complete your studies you are no longer eligible.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Fill in the request in the Neptun Requests interface between 1 and 15 October 2026; the committee evaluates and completes decisions by 30 October 2026; the award is recorded in Neptun and paid in 12 monthly instalments to the registered HUF account.
